_comment: Per-repo adoption manifest (feature 078, FR-019/020/021). The sole authority for whether FR-008 binds in glpnet. Every FR-017 glpnet area MUST be enumerated. An area absent from this list is an ERROR (FR-020), never a pass and never equivalent to non-adoption. MVP: the reference check is adopted; the four real glpnet areas flip to 'adopted' as each US4 retrofit lands.
